the identifier hash

operations, commands, events, notifications, moments and many other types are identified by a 32-bit value that is the   bitwise not of the standard crc-32 of the upper-case name    zlib  crc32 , then  ~  .

import zlib

engine executable  civilizationvi.exe 

the game program itself, as opposed to gamecore: the settings it reads, the switches it accepts, and the debug console it hosts. none of this needs a mod,
but much of it is   debug and configuration functionality that firaxis never documented  , so treat the

option files reference

the exe registers 194 options. the game writes them into four text files in  appdata/local/firaxis games/sid meier's civilization vi/ ; each file is read at start-up and the comment line above every key is the description the exe carries. keys are unique across all files, n

command-line switches

pass these in the steam launch options  or a shortcut . all are read by civilizationvi.exe. nothing here has been tried in the running game; the behaviour is read from the code.

debug console

commands typed into the in-game debug console  the  uie_debugconsoleinput  event . each handler of the event matches its own commands;  help all  prints the combined list. the console is only reachable when the debug ui is enabled  see  enabledebugmenu  in  the option files  options
